description.html: The Atman AT-F101 is an internal aquarium filter with a built-in pump, labeled Internal Filter on the box. It sits in the water and attaches to the glass with suction cups, so nothing needs to be mounted outside the tank.

Water is drawn in through the lower part of the housing and passes through a filter sponge that traps food particles, waste and plant debris. Over time, beneficial bacteria settle on the sponge and break down ammonia and nitrites, so the filter also provides biological filtration. Clean water exits at the top and keeps the aquarium water moving.

The AT-F101 has a compact, slim housing that is easy to hide behind plants or decor. It suits smaller fish tanks. Ask us about the flow rate and recommended tank volume before buying, so the filter matches your aquarium and animals.

Always unplug the filter before cleaning. Rinse the sponge in aquarium water during a partial water change, never under the tap, so you do not kill the beneficial bacteria. Replace the sponge only when it falls apart or no longer keeps its shape.
